evidence.notes: ApexPages.Message construction and getSummary/getSeverity in local test.

source.content: @isTest private class UIApexPagesMessageConstructionTest { @isTest static void messageConstructionAndAccessors() { ApexPages.Message msg = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Test summary'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, msg.getSeverity()); System.assertEquals('Test summary', msg.getSummary()); ApexPages.addMessage(msg); System.assertEquals(true, ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assertEquals(true, ApexPages.hasMessages(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR)); System.assertEquals(1, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); } @isTest static void threeArgConstructor() { ApexPages.Message msg = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'summary', 'detail'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, msg.getSeverity()); System.assertEquals('summary', msg.getSummary()); System.assertEquals('detail', msg.getDetail()); } }
